title: Awakening as Klein
summary: Zhou Mingrui awakens in an unfamiliar body and receives Klein Moretti's memories, establishing the dual-root identity that drives the story.

title: Klein Moretti becomes the embodied self
summary: After the memory influx, Zhou recognizes the body and social life he now inhabits as Klein Moretti.

title: The mysterious host persona begins
summary: Above the gray fog, Klein deliberately chooses to maintain a mysterious and powerful image rather than present himself as another confused victim.

title: Code name: The Fool
summary: Klein explicitly tells Audrey and Alger to address him as The Fool, formalizing the identity that will preside over the Tarot Club.

title: Sherlock Moriarty introduced
summary: In Backlund, Klein gives Mrs. Sammer the fake name Sherlock Moriarty as he begins constructing a civilian cover.

title: Private detective cover goes public
summary: Klein advertises Sherlock Moriarty as a private detective at 15 Minsk Street, turning the alias into a functioning public profession.

title: The World is created
summary: Using the All-Black Eye's Marionettist-related effect above the gray fog, Klein creates a fake Tarot Club member and names the persona The World.

title: First Tarot Gathering appearance
summary: The World appears as a separate Tarot Club member, letting Klein move requests and commissions away from The Fool's direct persona.

title: Gehrman Sparrow identity acquired
summary: Through Sharron's circle, Klein obtains documents for a bounty-hunter identity named Gehrman Sparrow before entering the Five Seas.

title: The crazy adventurer persona hardens
summary: Klein consciously calibrates Gehrman as a cold, somewhat crazy adventurer and bounty hunter, using that reputation as part of his operating style.

title: Dwayne Dantès identity created
summary: Klein obtains a new black-market identity and identification documents naming him Dwayne Dantès while preparing to return to Backlund.

title: Three-layer tycoon cover designed
summary: Klein defines Dwayne as a mysterious Desi Bay tycoon and deliberately builds deeper fallback layers to survive routine background checks.

title: Official public appearance
summary: Dwayne Dantès formally enters Backlund public life and begins building the household and social network required for the tycoon role.

title: Wandering-magician phase begins
summary: Klein begins moving through the postwar world as an unnamed wandering magician who grants wishes as part of Miracle Invoker acting.

title: Purpose of the wandering role clarified
summary: The text explicitly ties the wandering-magician role to accumulating wishes, displaying miracles, digesting the potion and witnessing the human cost of war.

title: Name revealed: Merlin Hermes
summary: At the end of a Belltaine incident, Klein publicly identifies the wandering Miracle Magician persona as Merlin Hermes.
